changes: Raised and deepened central pediment and niche; widened banded piers; opened roundel.
Flat projecting cornices replace central attic turret hip roofs.
Two round central attic dormers and turned ridge balustrades.
Deep layered clock archivolts, brick-coloured octagonal drums and copper cornices.
Sixteen dormer scroll/crown assemblies and two fine iron balconies.
Painted sashes, carved pilaster capitals, frieze medallions and pediment details.
reference: Kajima restoration completion exterior album images 01,02,04,06,08,09,13; Tokyo Station City external-wall details; JRE Design project description.
limitations: Photographic interpretation fitted to inherited station footprint and floor heights, not measured facade reconstruction.
Fine carving and sheet-metal profiles are simplified native geometry.
The aerial reference predates the present plaza; no obsolete plaza arrangement is copied.
V15 underground cutaways, V14 ground/catenary and all rolling stock remain.
